formula.canonicalInci: AQUA (WATER, EAU), SODIUM LAURETH SULFATE, SODIUM CHLORIDE, COCAMIDOPROPYL BETAINE, PISUM SATIVUM (PEA) PEPTIDE, HYDROXYPROPYL GUAR HYDROXYPROPYLTRIMONIUM CHLORIDE, PARFUM (FRAGRANCE), SODIUM BENZOATE, COCO-GLUCOSIDE, GLYCERYL OLEATE, CITRIC ACID, PEG-7 GLYCERYL COCOATE, GLYCOL DISTEARATE, LAURETH-4, HYDROGENATED CASTOR OIL, PEG-120 METHYL GLUCOSE DIOLEATE, SODIUM HYDROXIDE, BENZYL ALCOHOL, PROPYLENE GLYCOL, LEUCONOSTOC/RADISH ROOT FERMENT FILTRATE

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: SLES at position 2 gives effective ordinary cleansing, but CAPB, later coco-glucoside and early peptide/cationic-care signals prevent a strong-reset classification.

conditioningLevel.rationale: High: pea peptide at position 5, cationic guar at position 6 and several lipid/refatting/waxy routes create a substantial rinse-off care system for split-end/damage positioning.

weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: early cationic guar plus peptide, glyceryl oleate and hydrogenated castor oil can leave residue, but SLES/CAPB cleansing, no silicone and no-weight positioning keep this below high.

focusPrimary.rationale: Repair: revealed claims center on split-end and damaged-hair sealing, and the formula has a compatible early peptide, cationic polymer and refatting care architecture.

focusSecondary.rationale: Empty: split-end sealing and damaged-hair claims are one repair story, with no distinct secondary volume, shine, clarifying or scalp-active route.

usageRole.rationale: Regular: directions are standard wet-hair distribution and rinse-out use; regular application wording confirms ordinary recurring use rather than treatment or reset usage.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Not targeted: the product is positioned for hair-fiber damage and split-end sealing, not sensitive, itchy, dry-feeling or uncomfortable scalp.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Not supported: the complete canonical formula contains neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole.

thicknesses.rationale: High conditioning plus peptide/cationic/refatting routes can reduce lift on fine hair, even without silicone.
Moderate cleansing, high repair conditioning and moderate weight fit normal split-end-prone hair.
Coarse hair benefits from the high care system while the moderate weight remains acceptable.

primary.rationale: The packet does not target sensitive, itchy, dry-feeling, oily or dandruff scalp; the supported production route is the ordinary balanced shampoo bucket.
